Order service API

All responses are JSON unless noted. Requests are made to the address this service is running on.

GET /docs
    This page (plain text).

GET /value
    Returns {"value": <integer>}. No authentication.

POST /token
    Returns {"token": "<token>"}. No authentication. Send the token on authenticated
    requests in the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.
    Returns {"page", "total_pages", "items", "next"}. "next" is the path of the following
    page, or null on the last page.
    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.
    region is one of: north, south, east, west. discount_pct is a whole-number percentage.

input.content:
import json
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

raw = json.load(open("/tmp/recon/raw.json"))
listings = raw["listings"]
customers = raw["customers"]

seen = {}
dupes = 0
for o in listings:
    if o["id"] in seen:
        dupes += 1
        assert seen[o["id"]] == o, o["id"]
    else:
        seen[o["id"]] = o
print("listings", len(listings), "distinct", len(seen), "dupes", dupes)

lo = datetime(2025, 3, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
hi = datetime(2025, 6, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

total = Decimal(0)
by_region = Counter()
n = 0
boundary = []
for o in seen.values():
    if o["status"] != "shipped":
        continue
    t = datetime.strptime(o["placed_at"][:19], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    off = o["placed_at"][19:]
    if off == "Z":
        delta = 0
    else:
        sign = 1 if off[0] == "+" else -1
        hh, mm = off[1:].split(":")
        delta = sign * (int(hh) * 60 + int(mm))
    utc = t.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    from datetime import timedelta
    utc = utc - timedelta(minutes=delta)
    if lo <= utc < hi:
        n += 1
        c = customers[o["customer_id"]]
        d = Decimal(o["amount_cents"]) * (100 - c["discount_pct"]) / 100
        r = int(d.quantize(Decimal(1), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
        total += r
        by_region[c["region"]] += r
        if abs(utc - lo) < timedelta(hours=14) or abs(utc - hi) < timedelta(hours=14):
            boundary.append((o["id"], o["placed_at"], str(utc)))

print("qualifying", n, "total", int(total), dict(by_region))
print("near-boundary qualifying orders:", len(boundary))
for b in boundary:
    print("  ", b)
# how many shipped orders sit just outside range only because of offset
local_only = 0
for o in seen.values():
    if o["status"] == "shipped":
        naive = o["placed_at"][:10]
        if naive in ("2025-03-01", "2025-05-31", "2025-06-01", "2025-02-28"):
            local_only += 1
print("shipped orders with dates touching the edges (local date):", local_only)
print("status values:", Counter(o["status"] for o in seen.values()))
print("offset forms:", Counter(o["placed_at"][19:] if o["placed_at"][19:] == "Z" else "offset" for o in seen.values()))
print("customers:", len(customers), "discount values:", sorted(set(c["discount_pct"] for c in customers.values())))
